Divergence 1.5.1 (73)

  • Fixes a misleading message in Settings. The connection test could report “Reachable but pin mismatch” for network failures that had nothing to do with certificates. It now names what actually failed.
  • Better self-diagnosis. When a Mac stops reporting its status, it now records why in its own log instead of failing silently — so a problem can be diagnosed from a log you send us rather than by asking you to run anything.
  • Nothing else in this build changes how a session looks or behaves.

Divergence 1.5.1 (72)

  • Fixes a window-sizing bug introduced in (70). On a Mac with several paired devices the window grew taller than the screen, which pushed the launch animation half off the bottom edge and hid the crash-reporting notice entirely unless you were in fullscreen.
  • The window now opens and resizes normally regardless of how many devices you have paired.
  • Nothing else in this build changes how a session looks or behaves.

Divergence 1.5.1 (71)

  • The crash-reporting notice no longer covers your devices. In (70) it floated over the middle of the device list and could sit on top of a card’s name and its “Tap to link securely” button. It now sits in the bottom-left corner with the list resized around it, so nothing is hidden behind it.
  • Nothing else in this build changes how a session looks or behaves.
